fonts.heading: font-head (display font, use tracking-tight for crispness)
fonts.mono: font-mono (use for data points, metrics, logs, technical IDs)
fonts.body: sans (system default or configured sans for general readability)

hierarchy.section_title: text-lg sm:text-xl font-head tracking-tight text-white/90 border-b border-white/10 pb-2 mb-4

tokens.ai_cyan: var(--ai-cyan) - use for AI specific features, glowing accents
tokens.primary_blue: var(--primary-blue) - use for active states, main brand color
tokens.low_risk: var(--low-green) - success, low risk, positive trend
tokens.high_risk: var(--high-orange) - danger, high risk, action required

colors.usage: Use color sparingly. 90% of the UI should be dark shades of gray/blue (slate) to allow the status colors (green, amber, orange, red) to pop. Use AI Cyan for 'continuous AI control' glowing accents.

visual_enhancers.depth_layering: Use crisp 1px borders (border-white/10) rather than heavy shadows to define cards in the dark theme. Use inner shadows/glows for active elements.
visual_enhancers.glass_grain: For overlays, sticky headers, or floating menus: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-white/10. NEVER use purely transparent backgrounds. Add an SVG noise texture overlay at 2-3% opacity across the main app background to reduce digital flatness and add a 'board-grade' tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use subtle drop shadows on status metrics. Example: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_var(--ai-cyan)].

page_shell.container: w-full max-w-none px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 (No max-width, fills the screen)
page_shell.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-4 lg:gap-6
page_shell.rhythm: Group related cards with clear section headers. Maintain strict symmetry in the 12-col grid (e.g., 4 cards of col-span-3, 3 cards of col-span-4, or 2 cards of col-span-6).

layouts.dashboard_grid: Full-width masonry or strict CSS grid. Avoid dead space by ensuring child elements stretch. Add `align-items: stretch` to grid rows.

card_spans.kpi_row: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3 (4 items per row on desktop)

card_anatomy.wrapper: flex flex-col bg-slate-900/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-200 h-full backdrop-blur-sm
card_anatomy.header: flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/5
card_anatomy.header_title: text-sm font-head font-medium tracking-tight text-white/90 flex items-center gap-2
card_anatomy.header_badge: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5
card_anatomy.header_badge_live: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 (with a pulsing 4px dot: w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-green-400 animate-pulse)
card_anatomy.footer: px-5 py-3 bg-slate-950/30 border-t border-white/5 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/40 flex items-center justify-between

kpi_stat_card.layout: Use the standard card anatomy. The body should contain the `metric_value` and a trend indicator.
kpi_stat_card.trend_up: text-red-400 (for risk) or text-green-400 (for performance) flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-mono
kpi_stat_card.trend_down: text-green-400 (for risk reduction) flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-mono

chart_card.recharts_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT USE Recharts ResponsiveContainer. It crashes React 19. Use a fixed-height/fixed-width div wrapper or standard SVG charting techniques, or pass explicit pixel dimensions to Recharts elements. Ensure charts fit neatly within the ChartBox wrapper without overflowing.

empty_state.wrapper: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full min-h-[200px] w-full p-8 text-center border border-dashed border-white/10 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/20
empty_state.title: text-sm font-head text-white/60 mb-1
empty_state.action: mt-4 text-xs font-mono text-[var(--ai-cyan)] hover:brightness-110 transition-colors

motion.hover_states: Cards should have subtle border brightens (`hover:border-white/20`). Buttons get `active:scale-95`. DO NOT use `transition-all`. Use `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`, or `transition-opacity` with `duration-200`.
motion.live_data: Use a subtle pulsing dot (`animate-pulse`) next to 'LIVE' badges to indicate real-time data streams.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes APCA/WCAG contrast ratios. Muted text should not fall below text-white/40.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: `data-testid="kpi-residual-risk"` or `data-testid="nav-executive-dashboard"`.

general: Avoid 'AI slop' gradients. Stick to a highly structured, data-dense, symmetric grid.
Remove dead space by allowing the grid to fill the entire screen width (remove max-w-7xl, use w-full max-w-none).
Scale padding for mobile (px-4) to desktop (lg:px-8).

Never use a completely transparent background for headers, modals, or dropdowns. Always use a solid dark background or a heavily blurred background with high opacity (e.g., bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md).
Use JavaScript (.js) or JSX (.jsx) for files. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure all charts use the fixed-height ChartBox approach avoiding Recharts ResponsiveContainer.
Integrate the HSL CSS variables directly into Tailwind classes via inline styles or tailwind config (e.g., `text-[var(--crit-red)]` or `bg-[var(--ai-cyan)]`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this look like a premium, board-grade, executive command center.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating elements, but NEVER fully transparent.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should be left-aligned for data readability.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭). Use clean SVG icons (lucide-react or phosphor-icons).
Include a `data-testid` on all interactive elements.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
